title: Guitar
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body of acoustic guitar -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='30' ry='26' fill='#d98a3c'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='30' ry='26' fill='none' stroke='#f0b46a' stroke-width='3'/>
  <!-- upper bout shading -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='18' ry='12' fill='#e39b4d'/>
  <!-- sound hole -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='62' r='9' fill='#5b3a1e'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='62' r='9' fill='none' stroke='#f2c07a' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='62' r='12' fill='none' stroke='#f7d9a8' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- bridge -->
  <rect x='42' y='82' width='16' height='5' rx='2' fill='#8a5a2b'/>
  <rect x='42' y='82' width='16' height='2' rx='1' fill='#c98f52'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x='45' y='16' width='10' height='34' fill='#7a4e26'/>
  <rect x='45' y='16' width='3' height='34' fill='#a06a38'/>
  <!-- frets -->
  <rect x='45' y='24' width='10' height='1.5' fill='#e8c79a'/>
  <rect x='45' y='31' width='10' height='1.5' fill='#e8c79a'/>
  <rect x='45' y='38' width='10' height='1.5' fill='#e8c79a'/>
  <!-- headstock -->
  <rect x='43' y='6' width='14' height='12' rx='3' fill='#4a2c14'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='9' r='1.8' fill='#ffe9b0'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='9' r='1.8' fill='#ffe9b0'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='15' r='1.8' fill='#ffe9b0'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='15' r='1.8' fill='#ffe9b0'/>
  <!-- strings -->
  <line x1='47.5' y1='16' x2='47.5' y2='86' stroke='#fff3d6' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='16' x2='50' y2='86' stroke='#fff3d6' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='52.5' y1='16' x2='52.5' y2='86' stroke='#fff3d6' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- highlight on body -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='70' rx='9' ry='12' fill='#f2b06a' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
